sources.note: Own site places the winery at Chacra 186, General Roca, founded 1909 with 160 ha of its own vineyards, and publishes daily guided visits.
Current member listing, but under the CABA commercial office rather than the winery.

notes: The trade directory files this producer in CABA; the row follows the winery's own site to General Roca. `general roca` had no centroid key — the name repeats in Córdoba and Entre Ríos — so an override was added for the patagonia region.
